{{translated title}} ---- [[File:Pocket Monsters PikaVee Soothing DAYS art.png|thumb|250px|Pocket Monsters: PikaVee's Soothing DAYS]] (Japanese: '''{{j|ポケットモンスター　ピカブイのほっこり{{ruby|ＤＡＹＳ|デイズ}}}}''' ''Pocket Monsters: PikaVee's Soothing DAYS'') is a colored {{pkmn|manga}} written by {{j|すずきさなえ}} Sanae Suzuki and illustrated by {{j|ふじのきともこ}} Tomoko Fujinoki. It was serialized in the ''{{wp|Pucchigumi}}'' magazine from the June 2019 issue (released on April 30, 2019) to the September 2020 issue (released on July 31, 2020). It is followed by [[Welcome! Pokémon Café: PikaVee's Mixing à la mode]]. The collected volume is 32 pages long. ==Publications== {{publications/h|LGPE}} {{publications|cover=Pocket Monsters PikaVee Soothing DAYS.png|edition=First|country={{color2|000|Pokémon in Japan|Japan}}|company=Shogakukan|date=June 25, 2020|ISBN=9784097250722}} {{publications|cover=Pocket Monsters PikaVee Soothing DAYS CN.png|edition=First|country={{color2|000|Pokémon in mainland China|Mainland China}}|company=Beijing Science and Technology Publishing Co.,Ltd.|date=June 30, 2025|ISBN=9787571446482}} |} ==Chapters== [[File:Pocket Monsters PikaVee Soothing DAYS inside cover.png|thumb|250px|Inside cover]] The collected volume contains the first 13 chapters published in ''Pucchigumi''. {| class="roundtable c" style="background:#{{colorschemelight|LGPE}}; border:3px solid #{{colorschemedark|LGPE}}" !
